# BrineSpace asset pipeline and working workflow

## Ocean environmental replacements and review - September 30, 2026

For terrain, small life and rock/debris replacements, follow the room skill's

[environment workflow](../skills/brinespace-room-pipeline/references/environment.md)

and [production contract](ENVIRONMENT_PRODUCTION_CONTRACT.md). Preserve immutable

masters, exact prompts, rejected candidates and selected export hashes. Use image

generation for painting; packaging performs recorded alpha crop and isotropic

resampling without silent colour changes. Register every raster version in its

source ledger and keep whole literal runtime paths with cached raw-PNG loading.

Review source/pale and production-tinted/dark composites at measured cell scale,

then full habitat fields with production fog and station light. Check grain and

silhouette hierarchy, not merely export dimensions. Decorative variants derive

from saved region/placement data without changing map state or consuming gameplay

RNG; preserve old material fallback, continuous UVs and existing habitat hooks.

Extend the runtime loader regression and use the combined native review when this

scope changes. Isolate APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA and fingerprint the entire real

profile before/after. Documentation closeout needs no repeat native tests.

The [session closeout](OCEAN_ART_SESSION_CLOSEOUT_2026-09-30.md) records source

integration and final evidence. Source audit, native appearance, owner approval

and actual executable validation remain separate stages.

## Ocean family review and closeout — September 30, 2026

Reconcile selected identities against immutable source ledgers and actual whole-path

renderer bindings. `tools/audit_ocean_family.py` verifies this continuation's

30 selections, 92 registered rasters and read-only release dependency closure.

`tools/review_ocean_asset_family.ps1` covers native source/tint scale boards,

| Work | Maintained procedure | Evidence needed |

|---|---|---|

| Bought props (pre-v2: BRINE Core, corridors, seabed scenery) | [Room skill](../skills/brinespace-room-pipeline/SKILL.md) and its tileset reference | Registry integrity, protected-key comparison, live/Studio views and relevant door approaches |

| Seabed, scenery, terrain, wrecks | [Environment contract](ENVIRONMENT_PRODUCTION_CONTRACT.md) | Source provenance, powered/surveyed native view, unchanged occupancy unless deliberately changed |

| Playable package | [Release workflow](RELEASE_WORKFLOW.md) | Frozen dependencies, exact PCK audit, actual release journey; native Mac evidence separately |

| Session closeout | [Claude handoff](CLAUDE_HANDOFF_2026-09-24.md) | Current decisions, local state, evidence limits, concrete unresolved work and saved task inventory |

Follow the [visual bible](BRINESPACE_VISUAL_AESTHETIC_BIBLE.md). Compose believable

work areas with large/medium equipment, physical supports, useful operator space

and circulation derived from actual ports. Do not fill floor with accessories or

shrink equipment unnaturally to satisfy a geometry check. Visual overlap can form

an intentional assembly; distinguish it from clipping or an inaccessible station.

Review effective live props before adding furniture: an old functional host may

remain underneath. Studio shows some dressing/common decorations that live rooms

filter. Free placement is its default; `issues()` is intentionally quiet until

that toggle is off. Wall decorations remain paused by their production flag.

Do not change these decisions just to make an older test pass.

Inspect source pixels, actual gameplay scale and relevant production rotations.

Compare underwater scenery under powered, surveyed lighting before diagnosing

missing art. Fog-hidden diagnostic captures do not approve brighter exterior art.

Bake affected cards only after the final visual change; bind reviews to current

hashes. A later card change invalidates an earlier card-specific visual decision.

The owner's Graveyard Keeper reference is a pending direction discussion at this

handoff. A screenshot/reference request alone does not select a camera conversion.

Recover the session's unavailable detail before treating any proposal as accepted.

Preserve exact source provenance and canonical builders. Rebuild into a separate

candidate location and compare before promotion. Missing originals are a blocker

to a reproducibility claim, not permission to generate replacements. Local

Higgsfield free run. New unrelated generation scope needs an owner request.

## Tests, reports and checkpoints

Use `python tools/run_tests.py --list` and `tests/index.json` to choose the changed

subsystem; render-bound tests need the native lane on a real display. Read logs as

well as exit codes. Wait for observable startup and checkpoint restoration, not a

fixed number of frames. An unexplained failure merits a small state probe before

changing expectations. Isolate both profile files and loaded MetaState memory.

Preserve a frozen save and load a disposable copy. `RunSave.read` supplies `_path`;

Continue adopts it, and Conclude Expedition can delete the loaded file. Assert a

nonempty disk read and the expected seed, cycle, rooms, resources and crew so a

fresh loop cannot masquerade as successful restoration. Check visible framing

separately from state equality. Continue currently focuses BRINE intentionally.

Normal-play evidence retains paid costs, resource failure rules, dealt hands and

finite deposits. Label supplied fixtures and checkpoint chains explicitly. Exclude

intermediate conclusion awards from copied profiles. Automated paid play does not

establish human pacing, listening or continuous motion acceptance.

For performance, compare the same input, active phase, viewport and workload.

GPU readback capture is not a clean timing baseline; simulation CPU time excludes

rendering. Record tail spikes as well as means. Faster is not equivalent to smooth.

F7/F8 and the existing soak/report tools are the first diagnostic route.

Carrying pivots use loaded neutral pickup endpoints with feet under the hips;

### Wearable angles follow the body, not evenly numbered source cells

Register rotating equipment to the actual authored shoulder/head projection.

An evenly spaced generated strip need not match the body clip's angular pacing:

discard a too-frontal first interior rather than showing the face after the torso

has turned away. Closely related body poses may share an equipment angle; record

that reuse explicitly. Check small rear hardware as well as overall shell shape.

A wrong rear panel can remain readable drift even when all body pixels and joins

are exact. A loader coverage inventory proves state selection, not visual approval.

### Shared-source material masks and concatenated turn timing

Reusing a checked helmet angle atlas reduces independent design drift; it does

not remove the need to fit actual body angles or discard generated endpoints.

Grade clear blue-glass highlights independently from neutral graphite/silver and

warm skin using frozen master-derived transforms. Neutral-only mapping can leave

bright visor flashes untouched. Never normalize exposure frame by frame.

When concatenating clips with identical registered midpoint art, merge duplicate

midpoint references and add both holds; retain the intended total clock. Record

source copies as derived coverage, not newly authored in-betweens. Compare the

result against the actual runtime clock: Bill's candidate halves retain two800ms

quarters,while the older consumer uses680ms halves. Installation must settle that

timing/movement behavior deliberately. Exact joins and green manifests do not

prove consistency in the following interior frame or natural motion in-game.

For wearable source reconstruction, trace fitted runtime components back to their

original high-resolution master art. Enlarged tiny runtime crops are useful for

scale/color review but can invite simplified or invented hardware in generation.

Veld's rear/east reconstruction improved when original helmet sources supplied

the recessed ports, grille, trim and gasket construction. Keep runtime grading

and cardinal component pixels authoritative; grade a raw intermediate once.

Do not include a conflicting-direction turn sheet as a continuity reference for

an opposite turn: the first north/west attempt copied right-facing intermediates.

Keep directional masters explicit and review every authored slot before fitting.

Tightly packed generated cells can include disconnected pixels from neighbors;

inspect alpha components during extraction and remove detached fragments before

registration. Preserve sources, masks and exact body-pixel proofs. Quantize GIF

preview durations by cumulative boundaries to retain the full cycle length;

manifest/native timing remains the runtime authority.

### Partial animation overrides must not silently replace gait strides

A partial action pack can inherit unrelated strideDistanceCells from its base

manifest. Loading it after newer locomotion can silently restore older gait

cadence even when its action frames/timing are correct. Keep carrying overrides

scoped to carry;Bill action/timing/fitting imports use load_stride_overrides=false

while selected locomotion owns walk cadence. Default behavior for other actors

is preserved. Validate actual loader order and resolved gait values,not only the

manifest that originally declared the intended stride.

Native checks must record their scope:exact selected pixels,clocks and offscreen

contacts do not prove whole-station movement/occlusion or owner acceptance. Assert

the actual resolved user:// path,retain each interval’s before/after fingerprints,

and distinguish a fresh screenshot from an older file left after parse failure.

Concurrent profile changes must be reported without attribution or restoration.

## Marsh animation owner closeout — October 4, 2026
The owner closed the session. Read docs/MARSH_SESSION_CLOSEOUT_2026-10-04.md and character/marsh-final-review-2026-10-04/REVIEW.md before reopening Marsh. Current ordered catalogue resolves 228 states / 1190 holds / 95 body manifests / 1018 unique sources. Historical studies and limits are evidence, not an active task list. No new generation, test batch, release or automated continuation is scheduled.

### Reusable finishing workflow
1. Resolve effective states in ordered catalogue order; freeze exact catalogue, manifests, source hashes and relevant controller/fixture inputs. A registry or old gallery can lag current selection.
2. Compare whole poses and source hashes before generating. Shared kneel/stand/work drawings can reuse an already accepted whole source while preserving three 200 ms finite holds and reverse order. Preserve coherent whole poses without local anatomy or colour patches.
3. Stage the smallest family, review complete source/native boards, then append only its effective-state overrides. Prove all other states and original timing/pivot/density unchanged. Bind admission receipts to reviewed sources and boards.
4. Separate held-pose selection, production contact/controller transitions, actual dispatched routes and full disk/title-screen Continue. Prescribed contact/facing/state is not autonomous route selection. Choose a target that lets the real route witness the intended direction.
5. Isolate every Godot run with scratch APPDATA and fingerprint the owner's real non-log files before/after. Retarget restored autosave paths. Report concurrent unrelated input edits explicitly; owner protection and whole-input stability are separate checks.
6. Transform capture coordinates through final viewport and grid canvas transforms; settle camera/layers before capture. Inspect full native context and complete source canvases. Preserve rejected crops even when mechanics pass. Encoded previews must retain merged final holds; decoded frame/time checks do not replace motion review.
7. Close at the accepted scope. Record selected assets, per-revision checks, retained visual residuals, failures and exclusions in one handoff. Mirror maintained skill references and link current status to it. Do not reopen historical TODOs without a new objective.
